description: This file defines the RetireHandler interface for handling retirement actions on Retireable objects within the OpenMRS API, specifically managing the process of marking objects as retired and setting related metadata.

classes.name: RetireHandler
classes.description: A generic interface for handling retirement actions on objects that implement the Retireable interface, ensuring retirement metadata is set appropriately.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Defines the method to handle retiring a Retireable object, setting 'retired' status, reason, who retired it, and when.
